scope: Marvell including completed Celestial and conditional Lumentum
assessment: Strong design-win and engineering moat; potential broader manufacturing/integration moat; limited pricing power against concentrated hyperscalers. Not a monopoly.

mechanisms.name: custom design switching costs
mechanisms.mechanism: Redesign validation firmware package board and qualification costs discourage mid-generation replacement

mechanisms.name: reusable mixed-signal/IP platform
mechanisms.mechanism: SerDes DSP custom ASIC photonics packaging reuse reduces design time and integration risk

mechanisms.name: InP laser fabrication reliability and qualification
mechanisms.mechanism: process/yield/packaging learning and field validation harder to replicate than schematic design
mechanisms.limit: Lumentum deal pending; Coherent alternative; capex and yield execution

mechanisms.name: Celestial optical package integration
mechanisms.mechanism: thermal stability and bandwidth density may improve architecture economics
mechanisms.limit: vendor claims require production deployment reliability and cost evidence

mechanisms.name: system co-design
mechanisms.mechanism: custom compute electrical and optical links switching laser supply can be optimized together

falsifiers: falling gross margin or FCF per diluted share despite revenue growth
customers shift internal design or competing platforms
